subject: gheatmap/ geom_tile at end of facet plot

messages.author: fa1f211f186c96e4
messages.subject: gheatmap/ geom_tile at end of facet plot
parts:
Hi! I would like to add a heatmap at the end of a facet plot but I cannot get geom_tile to work inside the facet plot.

library(ape)
library(ggtree)
tr <- rtree(30, tip.label = as.character(seq(30)))
p <- ggtree(tr)
d1 <- data.frame(id=tr$tip.label, location=sample(c("GZ", "HK", "CZ"), length(tr$tip.label), replace=TRUE))
facet_plot(p1, panel = 'tiles!', data = d1, geom = geom_tile, mapping = aes(x = location))
# Object location not found?

# tile plot should work fine?
ggplot(d1, aes(x = location, y = id)) + geom_tile()

# Or is there a way to add a gheatmap to a facet plot?
# I tried the following:

dHm <- as.data.frame(unclass(table(d1)))
dHm[dHm == 0] <- NA
dHm[] <- lapply(dHm, factor)
gheatmap(p, dHm)

# Is there some way to plot the heatmap at the end of the facet plot?
d2 <- data.frame(id=tr$tip.label, val=rnorm(length(tr$tip.label), sd=3))
p2 <- facet_plot(p, panel="dot", data=d2, geom=geom_point, aes(x=val), color='firebrick') + theme_tree2()
gheatmap(p2, dHm)
